decisions.reason: The DPA management tool for agencies still has its own page and some positive customer feedback, and as software it costs little to keep, so the option stays open while its value becomes clearer.
The hosting management platform is featured on the home page in both years, which suggests it has become a core offering with demonstrated value worth further commitment.
The configurable managed hosting plan fits the firm's established hosting business and is cheap to maintain alongside existing infrastructure, so there is no reason to give up the option yet.
Extended PHP security support is new, only mentioned briefly, and its demand depends on customers running outdated PHP versions, so it is uncertain but cheap to keep while results come in.
